full_details: The morning was Egeon again, the same man as Monday. Between rehearsal and the call the old letter was still on the nail, still with no day. At half past twelve Heminges called from Aldermanbury. Yesterday's boxes were the best since Whitsun. Saturday's share will be seventeen shillings or near it. August is four weeks dark, and five hired men who will eat whether you play or no. Half wages, five shillings a week, five pound for the month, out of the stock. You said pay it. He asked for the Labour's Won at Michaelmas. You said the thirty-first of April, and a king at Michaelmas, cut to the Master's measure. His knees are bad in the heat. His wife says Nick has had new shoes twice since Easter. The afternoon was Errors, and you were Egeon in it. At the Bell, the first time you have walked as far as Carter Lane since May, Hobbins was in after eight days: dust to the fetlock, oats dearer at every bait, no rain since Aylesbury. Anne: the hay is in and light, the barley stands short, the house is busy. Hamnet has a jay's feather by the Guild Pits and will not say where. Judith has a third ballad by ear. Susanna, on her own half-sheet: you wrote who and it should be whom. A queen would hear the gardeners only if she hid, for servants say everything, but not to your face. You laughed with your shoulders. You had nothing to send but a line of thanks. The Midsummer money went in June. The old letter stayed the old letter.
one_sentence: Heminges called with the book open, you told him to pay the five pound, and Susanna corrected who to whom.
title: Seventeen shillings, and Susanna's whom
